mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_steps (chat_message_id, session_id, step_order, step_type, content, step_data, created_at) VALUES (#{chatMessageId}, #{sessionId}, #{stepOrder}, #{stepType}, #{content}, #{stepData, typeHandler=org.linxing.linxing_agent.agent.handler.JsonbTypeHandler}::jsonb, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, chat_message_id, session_id, step_order, step_type, content, step_data, created_at FROM agent_steps WHERE chat_message_id = #{chatMessageId} ORDER BY step_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, chat_message_id, session_id, step_order, step_type, content, step_data, created_at FROM agent_steps WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY chat_message_id ASC, step_order ASC, id ASC
